footnotes: * Including sale of by-products.

† Ginseng is a perennial plant belonging to the Araliaceae family. Medical ginseng is prepared from five-year-old roots by boiling and drying. The Chinese have been in the habit of using it as a beverage and for medicinal purposes from time immemorial. Imports of this product from Chosen, Japan, America, and Manchuria into China reach a considerable amount every year. The so-called Kōryūsam ([?]), the ginseng grown and manufactured around the town of Kaijō (Songdo), which was once the seat of the Kōryū Dynasty of Korea, is greatly to the taste of the Chinese, so that the best ginseng manufactured by the Government Monopoly commands a price of 150 yen per kin on an average, while that of American origin commands 20 yen, Manchurian 8 yen, and Japanese 5 yen. The peculiar climatic and soil conditions in the vicinity of Kaijō undoubtedly give rise to the unique qualities of Kōryūsam, just as the peculiar conditions in Formosa account for its production of the best quality of camphor in the world. The medicinal value of ginseng from a scientific point of view is often doubted, if not altogether denied, by European authorities. But eminent scientists and physicians in Japan, such as Prof. Sayeki, Dr. Asahina, and others, are now proving its positive value. The product prepared by the Government Monopoly is at present exclusively placed on the Chinese market.

footnotes: * The Company Regulations of Chosen require business corporations to obtain the approval of the Government-General for their formation, or for the establishment of their main or branch offices in Chosen. Such is not the case in Japan where the formation of corporations or the establishment of offices is accomplished by the mere act of registration at law courts after fulfilling the requirements of the commercial law. In Chosen, much stricter control and supervision than that exercised over business corporations in the mother country is necessary, partly to guard those Koreans lacking in business knowledge and experience against irresponsible schemers, and partly to guard those Japanese and foreign capitalists more or less unacquainted with the real state of things in the Peninsula from unwarily investing in wild-cat enterprises. As a result of these restrictions, applications for the establishment of unsound corporations are decreasing, and business is undergoing a healthy development. transcriber_notes: Layout: p.148 upper right = part 1 (courts of higher instance); lower band of p.148 through p.150 = part 2, courts in printed order (each 地方法院 main row first, 支廳 blank, then its 支廳). The 備考 runs from p.150 lower left to the top of p.151 (ends before 登記及公證事務管轄區域).
Rows: part 1 = 4 as printed; part 2 = 58 as printed (11 地方法院 + 47 支廳).
Column head printed 管轉區域 (轉 for 轄) on p.148; normalised to 管轄區域 in column names — the misprint is noted here.
Part 1, row 高等法院, col 府、郡、島數: damaged/cramped at the foot of the column; reads as 二三 followed by a faint third character — left blank.
Part 1 row labels printed '平壤同', '大邱同' (= 平壤覆審法院, 大邱覆審法院); 所在地 of 京城覆審法院 printed '同　公平洞' (= 京城府公平洞). Kept as printed.
'○出張所數NN' (number of 出張所 = registry sub-offices) printed at the head of each main 地方法院 cell; the number kept in kanji as part of the text cell (as printed). 府面數 figures converted to Arabic numerals.

Kept as printed (probable misprints, not corrected): 江陵 row '江原道江陵郡、襄陽郡　鍾城郡' (no 、 before 鍾城郡; expected 杆城郡); 城津 row '光州郡' (expected 吉州郡); 松禾 所在地 '松禾郡松禾郡邑內里' and 管轄 '黃州邑松禾郡' (expected 黃海道); 大邱 row '高麗郡' (expected 高靈郡); 井邑 and 群山 rows '全羅南道' (these are in 全羅北道); 全州 所在地 '全州面花園町' (no 郡); 公州 row '靑陽郡(靑陽面、定山面、木面、赤谷面)' without ヲ除ク.
益山 is printed with a glyph resembling 盆 (盆山郡) in the 全州 and 群山 rows; transcribed as the glyph appears (盆).
忠淸/靑/淸 written with the old forms 淸・靑 as elsewhere in this book's files; the scan resolution does not clearly separate 淸/清 in this type.
濟州 row: 'ヲ除ク' clause printed partly in small type ('中面ヲ除ク').

Totals: no totals printed. Part-1 府郡島數 (counts of 府・郡・島) are not sums of part-2 府面數 (counts of 府・面), so no reconciliation applies. Part-2 府面數 sums per 地方法院 (for reference): 京城 376, 公州 272, 咸興 178, 淸津 82, 平壤 181, 新義州 194, 海州 212, 大邱 290, 釜山 259, 光州 270, 全州 202; all 2516.

Layout: columns 署名 / 所在地 / 管轄區域 (printed in three runs per line). 署名 kept as printed: 「○○ 同」 where the book writes 同 (= 警察署) under the preceding 警察署 entry; full 「○○警察署」 where printed so.
The 道警察部 line is printed in bold with a ● mark (mark not transcribed); it is kept as the first row with its 所在地 and 管轄區域 (e.g. 「京畿道一圓」).
Numerals inside addresses (丁目, 番地, 面 lists) kept in kanji as printed, following the house style for addresses; no figures to convert.
淸/靑 written in the old form (淸, 靑); the scan cannot clearly separate 清/淸, 青/靑.
Includes the 警察官講習所 line printed before 京畿道警察部 (no 管轄區域 printed → "").

The Seoul 署 have long run-on 管轄區域 paragraphs; transcribed verbatim with line breaks removed. Punctuation kept as printed, incl. missing 。 at line ends (「花園町倭城町」, 「水標町笠井町」, 「堅志洞三淸洞」, 「和泉町西小門町」, 「三坂通岡崎町漢江通」) and unbalanced parentheses (鍾路署: 「二、三番地昌德宮署ヲ除ク)」, 「一二一番地本町署ヲ除ク)」; 西大門署: 「京城驛構內ハ本町署)」).
京城西大門警察署 管轄區域: the mark after 「中林洞」 is a small damaged sign (possibly 「(」 or 「、」) — written [?].
「紅杷洞」 printed with 木 radical (杷) as far as can be seen; kept.
Row 永登浦: the 署名 「永登浦」 is printed in small type squeezed between 水原 and 金浦 (a later insertion); the small type is blurred but reads 永登浦 by eye.
The list runs from p.168 (lower-left half) through p.169 to the top of p.170 (開城).

transcriber_notes: Rows: 10 year rows (昭和4-13, 酒造年度) + 總數 + 13 provinces = 24 rows x 45 figure columns, as printed. The 道別 header '道 別 (昭和13酒造年度)' sits above the 總數 row (split: 道 on the left page, 別 (昭和13酒造年度) on the right).
Check: for each of the 45 columns the 13 provinces sum to the printed 總數 row (all reconcile). The 總數 row equals the 昭和13 year row.

Group totals vs. components: for the province rows and 昭和11-13 the group 總數 equals the sum of its parts; for 昭和4-10 differences of 1-4 occur (rounding in the original; e.g. 昭和10 再製酒 總數 5,791 vs parts 5,795); kept as printed.

Scan is tilted: on the right-hand pages the columns sit up to ~20 px higher than the row numbers at the right edge, so figures were assigned by row order, not by height. In provinces 9-13 the 高粱酒 figures are staggered (2,539 / 102,741 stands level with the 燒酎 figures 88,447 / 1,335,412 of row 10; 28 / 909 level with 40,184 of row 13); assigned by that horizontal alignment (the row sums happen to agree, noted only as a check).
Rows 6 (慶尙北道) 釀造酒 其ノ他 9 / 281 and 7 (慶尙南道) 蒸餾酒 酒精 64 / 7,232 placed by the same row-order reading.
Column heading 再製酒 ウヰスキー is printed ウ(キ with an extra stroke)スキー; written ウヰスキー.

Row '總數' (道別), col '再製酒 — ウヰスキー — 稅額': printed 8,750 with a flaw on the 7 (looks like 8,150 at first glance); read 8,750 on an enlarged crop; it equals the 昭和13 row and the provinces (378 + 199 + 8,173) — used only as a check.
Row '〃11' etc.: figures in 其ノ他 / 酒精 columns printed as 0 are kept as '0'. Dashes written '—'.

table.caption_extra: 農業は產業中最重要の位置を占め、國民の經濟は一に之に依繫するものがあるから、本府は之が改良指導の途を講ずる爲、勸農機關を設置した。

rows: 京畿道水原に在り、農業・蠶絲業及畜產業の發達改良に關する調査及試驗、種苗・蠶種・種畜・種禽及種卵の配付、講習及講話等を行ふ。
全羅北道裡里に在り、專ら稻作に關する試驗調査を行ふ。
黃海道沙里院に在り、畑作に關する試驗調査を行ふ。
咸鏡南道甲山郡豊大面に在り、北鮮農事に關する試驗調査を行ふ。
全羅南道木浦に在り、專ら棉花に關する試驗調査・棉種子の育成配付等を行ふ。
平安南道龍岡に在り、專ら棉花に關する試驗調査、棉種子の育成配付等を行ふ。
全羅北道金堤に在り、專ら干拓に關する試驗調査を行ふ。
平安北道車輦館に在り、專ら蠶業に關する試驗調査を行ふ。
本場に附設し、蠶業に關する學理及實地を講習せしめ、昭和十二年迄の卒業生總數七百八十餘名に及んだ。
咸鏡北道慶源郡慶源面に在り、昭和七年咸鏡北道種馬所を國營に移管したもので、種牡馬・種牝馬を飼養して馬の生產を圖ると同時に、地方牝馬に種付して馬產の改良を圖つてゐる。
咸鏡北道明川郡阿間面及平安南道順川郡殷山面に在り、前者は昭和九年後者は昭和十二年新設せられたもので兩場共主として、緬羊の改良增殖を圖り原種羊の配給を事業としてゐる。
從來は道種苗場の名稱を以て農產の改良增產に關する試驗調査、種苗・種卵・種禽及種豚の配付又は種畜の種付、農事に關する講習・講話・傳習及實地指導を行ひ、昭和七年十月より道農事試驗場と改稱した。現在各道一箇所宛在りて京城・淸州・大田・裡里・光州・大邱・晋州・海州・平壤・定州(江界に支場を設く)・春川・咸興・鏡城(穩城に支場を設く)に設けられてゐる。
各道に一箇所宛を設置す。原蠶種の製造配付を爲すと共に、蠶業に關する試驗調査を行つてゐる。
朝鮮蠶業令の實施に依り、其の執行機關の一として各道に一箇所宛を設置し、蠶病の豫防及蠶種・桑苗の生產販賣・繭販賣に關する取締を爲す。
鮮米取引の斡旋と併せて其の宣傳を目的とし、朝鮮に於ける米穀業者及生產者を以て組織する任意團體であつて、本府及各道援助の下に成立し、鮮米の販路擴張に努めつゝある。
日滿緬羊協會朝鮮支部として昭和九年朝鮮緬羊協會の名稱の下に緬羊從業者を以て組織せられ、本府の緬羊獎勵計畫の側面的助成機關として緬羊の改良增殖及生產物の有效なる利用方法を講じてゐる。

transcriber_notes: Rows: 180 (one per office/section path).

Fold-out organisation chart (no folio, no running head) following printed p.10 (leaf p0032), whose prose ends '…分課狀況を表示すれば別紙の如くである'; chapter 行政 taken from the running head of p.10. Shot in three overlapping frames p0033 (right end: 總督官房 … 遞信局), p0034 (centre with title: 學務局 … 刑務所/保護觀察所), p0035 (left end: 鐵道局 … 傷痍軍人療養所). Overlaps transcribed once.
Columns follow the 1940 edition's file for the same chart (Chosen_Jijo_1940 p0022_1): 區分 / 官署・局・部 / 課・室等 (= 官署 / 部局 / 課) plus up to three levels of subordinate offices. Chart read right-to-left.
區分 '朝鮮總督府' = units under the 朝鮮總督府 brace (總督官房 … 中樞院); '朝鮮總督府所屬官署' = units on the line headed 朝鮮總督府所屬官署 (遞信局 … 傷痍軍人療養所).

Where 課・室等 is empty the unit hangs from the 官署/局 as a whole by a separate bracket or line: 殖産局 {地質調査所, 度量衡所} (separate line); 遞信局 {地方遞信局 … 飛行場}; 鐵道局 {地方鐵道局 … 病院}; 專賣局 {地方專賣局…, 出張所—派出所}; 道 {府 … 消防署} and a separate line {職業紹介所, 移出牛檢疫所, 道立醫院, 公立學校}; 稅關 {稅關支署, 稅關監視署, 稅關出張所}.
殖産局: 燃料選鑛研究所, 商工獎勵館, 鑿岩工養成所 are printed inside the same bracket as the 課 and are entered in 課・室等 (in 1940 they were in a separate column).
遞信局 電氣課 has a sub-bracket {第一課, 第二課}, entered as subordinate level 1. 鐵道局 庶務課 → {鐵道圖書館, 鐵道醫院}. 內務局 土木課—內務局土木出張所; 學務局 社會教育課—博物館.

專賣局: bracket {地方專賣局, 出張所—派出所}; under 地方專賣局 {販賣所, 出張所}; under that 出張所 {販賣所, 派出所}. 道: 郡 and 島 join by lines to {邑, 面}, expanded. 稅務監督局: 稅務署 printed below 稅務部 and entered as a subordinate office of 稅務監督局.
裁判所 / 檢事局 printed side by side under one heading; chains 高等法院—覆審法院—地方法院—{地方法院支廳, 地方法院出張所} and 高等法院檢事局—覆審法院檢事局—地方法院檢事局—地方法院支廳檢事分局 entered as in the 1940 file.

transcriber_notes: Rows: 179 (one per office/section path).

Fold-out organisation chart (no folio, no running head) between printed pp.12 and 13; p.13 (leaf p0026, running head 行政) cites it as 別紙. Chapter '二 行政' as in the mission prompt. Shot in overlapping frames: p0021 (fold edge only: 專賣局 販賣課 … 京城帝國大學 … 傷痍軍人療養所, partial), p0022 (right section: 總督官房 … 遞信局 part), p0023 (wide shot with title: 農林局 … 矯正院), p0024 (left section: 鐵道局 需品課 … 傷痍軍人療養所). Overlaps transcribed once.
Columns and conventions follow the 1942 edition's file (Chosen_Jijo_1942 p0033_1). Chart read right-to-left.

區分: '朝鮮總督府' = units under the 朝鮮總督府 heading (總督官房 … 中樞院); '朝鮮總督府所屬官署' = 遞信局 onward. The connecting line between 中樞院 and 遞信局 is too faint in the scan to see where the 朝鮮總督府 brace ends; the split follows the 1942 chart (遞信局 = 所屬官署).

Where 課・室等 is empty the unit hangs from the 官署/局 by a separate bracket or line: 殖産局 {地質調査所, 度量衡所}; 遞信局 {地方遞信局, 海事署—出張所, 貯金管理所, 郵便局, 電信局, 電話局, 飛行場}; 鐵道局 {地方鐵道局 … 病院}; 專賣局 {地方專賣局…, 出張所—派出所}; 道 {府 … 消防署} and a separate line {職業紹介所, 移出牛檢疫所, 道立醫院, 公立學校}; 稅關 {稅關支署, 稅關監視署, 稅關出張所}; 稅務署 printed below 稅務部 and entered as a subordinate office of 稅務監督局 (as in 1942).
Sub-links: 司政局 土木課—司政局土木出張所; 學務局 錬成課—博物館; 鐵道局 總務課 {鐵道圖書館, 鐵道醫院}; 遞信局 海事署—出張所. 專賣局: under 地方專賣局 {販賣所, 出張所}, under that 出張所 {販賣所, 派出所}. 道: 郡 and 島 join to {邑, 面}, expanded.

Changes from 1942 seen in this chart (as printed, not corrections): 總務局 and 司政局 replace 內務局/外事部/企畫部; 殖産局 has 鐵鋼課, 電氣第一課, 電氣第二課; 學務局 has 錬成課 and 編修課; 鐵道局 has 總務課, 整備課, 需品課; 稅關 has no 調査課; new 少年審判所, 矯正院, 生絲檢査所, 家畜衞生研究所, 附屬生藥研究所, 高地療養研究所; no 職業紹介所 on the main 所屬官署 line this year.
錬 (錬成課), 敎 (敎學研修所), 靑 written as printed / old form. 産 written as in the 1942 file.
No figures in this chart; no totals to check. No unreadable characters.

Part 1 place names: row 全島 極南 reads '七星岩' while row 高雄 極南 reads '七尾岩' (as printed; the glyph in the second looks like 尾). Other glyphs read from the scan at moderate size; e.g. 北斗郡大城庄下海墘厝 (墘), 新豐郡關廟庄龜洞, 臺中 極南 新高郡蕃地尖山頂, 北門郡七股庄十分塩 - one or two characters in the longer place names may be mis-seen.

Part 2: 9 rows as printed. Cross-check: part 2 平地 + 蕃地 = part 1 滿潮 area for every 州廳 except 臺中 (7,383.4269 printed vs 3,546.3418+3,837.0850 = 7,383.4268, difference 0.0001) - all other rows add exactly. Sum of the 8 平地 rows = 19,184.0957 (total reconciles). Sum of the 8 蕃地 rows = 16,789.4537; the printed 蕃地 total's last two digits are smudged/overprinted (read as 4538 but could be 4537 or 4598) - cell written '[?]' for 總數 蕃地. Sum of 滿潮 rows 臺北-澎湖 = 35,973.5495 = printed 全島 滿潮 35,973.5495 (reconciles).
Part 2 row 澎湖 蕃地: printed '…' (nil).
The column heading '州及廳' in part 2 and the intro sentence '本表ノ平地及蕃地面積ヲ再掲スレバ次ノ如シ' are printed under part 1.

The table runs over pp. 92-97: on each left page (92, 94, 96) the row labels and 渡航者 總數 to 其ノ他ノ有業者, on each right page (93, 95, 97) the 渡航者 家事使用人 and 無業 columns followed by the 歸航者 columns; rows were matched across the spread by order. The right-hand pages were read from crops straightened by 1 degree because the scan is tilted.

Row labels: the printed 昭和 3 年 / 〃 4 ... year labels are written out as 昭和3年 ... 昭和8年 (〃 expanded) followed by the row's 總數/男/女. In part 地方別 the row label is written as 本居地／渡航地／性 with ／ separating the levels, e.g. 臺北／中華民國 河北省／男; the printed brackets (中華民國 {...省) are shown as the level 中華民國 總數 (the 男/女 pair printed against 總數 in the bracket) and 中華民國 <省名>. The printed ditto mark 〃 stands for 男 in the rows 臺中／英領ボルネオ and 高雄／暹羅 and is kept as printed. 臺北／暹羅／男 and 臺北／佛領印度支那／女 are single-sex rows as printed (暹羅 is printed with the variant 暹, shown as 遷 in the scan). Region headings are printed with letter-spacing and written without spaces.

Part 年別: the printed heading is 年、本居地、渡歸航地及體性; the heading 地方別 (昭和8年) is printed across the two pages (地方 on p. 92, 別 (昭和8年) on p. 93). The top row of part 地方別 (總數／...) repeats 昭和8年 of part 年別 exactly.

Totals: every row's 總數 = sum of the 8 occupation columns + 家事使用人 + 無業 in both 渡航者 and 歸航者 (checked for all 194 rows; 臺南／中華民國 山東省／男 歸航者 總數 is unreadable so its sum could not be checked, its parts sum to 6). Printed sub-totals also reconcile in all 22 numeric columns: 總數 = 男 + 女; 總數 = 關東州 + 滿洲國 + 中華民國 總數 + 英領/米領/佛領/暹羅/蘭領 rows (male and female separately); 中華民國 總數 = sum of the provinces (male and female separately; except the unreadable cell); the 8 州廳 総數 sum to the 地方別 總數; 昭和8年 equals 地方別 總數. Every year row's 男 + 女 = 總數.

Row '臺南／中華民國 山東省／男', col '歸航者 — 總數': unreadable. The digit is printed as a tiny round 'o'-like glyph (a 0 or a damaged 6) between 5 and 5; marked [?]. The remaining cells of the row (商業 3, 其ノ他ノ有業者 2, 無業 1) would give 6.

Cells that are '…' are printed as dotted leaders. In 臺北／暹羅／男 the 渡航者 總數 shows a single stray dot among the leaders; written as …. Column assignment of sparse small figures was checked against the row sums and the printed sub-totals (this fixed 4 initial misplaced cells; no digit was changed by arithmetic).
The footnote marker-free table has no 備考; no units are printed in the heading (figures are persons).

transcriber_notes: Rows: 6 year rows (昭和 3-8年度) + 269 驛別 rows (昭和8年度) as printed; the 驛別 part runs over pp. 549-553 (frames p0300 right, p0301 both pages, p0302 both pages) and ends with 終.

Row-label convention: in print the 驛 names are split over three vertical columns (first character, middle characters, last character) beside a bracket giving the line; each name has been assembled from them. Line is written as a prefix, e.g. '本線 縱貫線 基隆', '本線 縱貫線 總數', '臺東線 花蓮港', '阿里山鐵道 嘉義'. 臺東線 has two 總數 rows (printed, the second one following the 本線/臺東線 bracket) written '臺東線 總數 (外)' (577,203) and '臺東線 總數 (內)' (579,081); 其ノ他ノ收入 and 諸支拂金 sub-rows are written with those headings as prefix. 總數 rows: '總數', '本線 總數'.

Printing: the three 運輸收入 columns (and in places the 手小荷物 columns) are printed slightly out of line (lower) with the row labels. Values were assigned to rows in order, and each revenue row was cross-checked by 旅客 + 貨物 = 總數 (differences below). Cells printed as … are '…'.

Station names read with less certainty (read from the 3-column layout; glyphs as seen): 縱貫線 '北五堵' (row 4 under 基隆 group: left glyph 北, middle 五, right 堵) and '北臺北' (left 北, middle 臺, right 北); 淡水線 '臺北裏取扱所' (裏 as printed); 縱貫線 '鹽埕' (left glyph read 鹽, right glyph 城/埕), '東門町' (left glyph 東); 宜蘭線 '貢寮庄', '冬山' (glyph 多/冬); 阿里山鐵道 '盧厝' (盧/廬), '朴子埔', '鹿麻產' (left glyph), '新竹崎'; 羅東森林鐵道 '歪歪' (歪仔歪? only 歪 and 歪 printed), '三星'; 臺東線 '里壠' (壠/壢), '初鹿尾', '馬驒' (right glyph 驒/蘭?), '壽'. The numeric cells are not affected.

Totals: station rows of every line were summed per column and compared with that line's printed 總數 (旅客 乘/降 and 手小荷物 發 columns reconcile exactly for every line). Not exact: 縱貫線 貨物 發 +6, 貨物 著 +6, 運輸收入 總數 +3, 旅客 -2 (sum of stations minus printed total); 宜蘭線 貨物 發 +999 (stations 506,865 vs printed 505,866; the printed 505,866 looks like a misprint of 506,866, since the six line totals then add up to 本線 總數 exactly; cell 116,793 for 四脚亭 and the total re-read twice), 貨物 著 +2, 運輸收入 總數 +1, 旅客 -1; 平溪線 貨物 +1/+1, 總數 -1, 旅客 +1; 淡水線 貨物 發 -1, 著 +1, 運輸收入 -1/-1/-1; 臺中線 貨物 發 -51 (stations sum 320,174 vs printed 320,225; cells re-read, as printed), 著 +1, 運輸收入 -1/+1/-1; 集集線 貨物 發 +1, 著 +1, 運輸收入 總數 -1, 旅客 +1 (printed total read 167,498, see below), 貨物 -1; 潮州線 貨物 著 +1, 總數 -1, 貨物 +1; 臺東線 (stations 花蓮港-臺東海岸 vs 內 總數) 貨物 發 -2, 著 +1, 貨物收入 -1; 阿里山鐵道 旅客收入 -2, 貨物收入 +1; 羅東森林鐵道 手小荷物 -/ 運輸收入 總數 +1, 旅客 +1. (Sign: stations minus total.)

Line totals vs 本線 總數: 乘, 降, 手小荷物 發/著 reconcile exactly; 貨物 發 -1,000 (see 宜蘭線), 貨物 著 -1; 運輸收入: 本線 總數 = sum of the six lines + 其ノ他ノ收入 595,062 - 諸支拂金 633,381 (總數, 旅客 and 貨物 all reconcile exactly). 臺東線: 總數 (外) 577,203 = 總數 (內) 579,081 + 其ノ他ノ收入 10,666 - 諸支拂金 12,544 reconciles. 本線 其ノ他ノ收入 650+63,925+530,487 = 595,062 and 諸支拂金 6,085+614,353+12,943 = 633,381 reconcile; 臺東線 457+3,536+6,673 = 10,666 and 12,478+66 = 12,544 reconcile.

Year rows: 昭和8 equals the 驛別 總數 row; 運輸收入 旅客+貨物 = 總數 in every year row except as listed. Year rows 手小荷物 發/著 differ in 昭和 4 (10,494,555 vs 10,494,550), 貨物 in 昭和 3 (4,998,159 vs 4,998,157), 昭和 6 (4,837,538/4,837,536), 昭和 7 (5,200,401/5,200,403), 昭和 8 (5,153,887/5,153,883) as printed.

LAYOUT: the table is a bracket (brace) tree printed in two blocks per page, read left block then right block, page after page (710 left, 710 right, 711 left, ...). Each row label here is the chain of ancestor labels from the braces joined with '／', then the salary grade as printed (stacked kanji numerals read as e.g. 六十五圓, 百二十七圓, 千八百二十圓; where a digit stack leaves out 二/一 the grade is as printed, e.g. 百十圓, 二百七十圓), or 總數 for a printed sub-total, or 日給 for the 日給 line. Ancestor names come from the braces; the top row 總數 (39,574) has no printed label of its own, and the unlabelled sub-total 25,097 sits at 國庫. State/廳 names (臺北州, 新竹州, 臺中州, 臺南州, 高雄州, 臺東廳, 花蓮港廳, 澎湖廳) are printed once as a bracket label at the left; they are repeated in the first column of every row. The 郡/市 label is printed letter-spaced.

IMAGE QUALITY: the scan is low-resolution (about 20 px per character). Kanji names (街, 庄, 町) were read with moderate confidence; where a character or name could not be made out it is written [?] (e.g. '[?]町'). In the 街庄ヲ置カサル蕃地 (unorganised aboriginal-area) lists the village names are small katakana ending in 社 and could not be read reliably; each unreadable name is written '[?]社' (the count was taken from the print, about +/-1 for names broken across lines). Only names that were clearly legible (e.g. 牡丹社, 平林社, 武界社, 霧社, 八仙山, 八通關, 合歡山, 能高山, 白石山, 富士社, 川中島社, 大南社, 紅頭嶼) are written out.
The heading '「街庄ヲ置カサル蕃地」' is copied as printed (街庄ヲ置カサル蕃地, no dakuten on サ).
No totals are printed, so no sums were checked. Many names are doubtful at this resolution; use this table as an index of the administrative divisions rather than as an exact gazetteer.

IMAGE QUALITY: on p. 11 (frame p0016) the 官署 and 所在地 columns are very blurred and vertically smeared; each place name was read column by column (one character column at a time). Place names with a [?] contain characters that could not be read; others were read with moderate confidence only. On p. 12 (frame p0017) all text is clear. Header words '總督府ヨリ' and '州廳ヨリ' are blurred in the scan (the last two glyphs are read as ヨリ).
Distance columns: 鐵道 (railway), 陸路 (road), 海路 (sea) in 粁, measured from the 總督府 and from the 州廳. '…' = nil as printed.

Layout: each printed band (upper and lower, left and right page) is one part, with the 數量(斤) block above and the 價額(圓) block below on the page; the parts follow reading order: 316 上段, 317 上段, 316 下段, 317 下段, then 318 上段, 319 上段, 318 下段, 319 下段. Digit groups: this volume separates digits in groups of four (e.g. '4 4568 2105'); joined and written with commas every three digits. Units are 圓 (單位圓) so e.g. '4 4568 2105' = 445,682,105.

The 州 name is printed once beside a brace; it is repeated on every row of its group. 臺東廳, 花蓮港廳, 澎湖廳 have no 郡: the 廳 name is placed in the 郡及市 column with an empty 州、廳 cell. The heading '州、廳、郡及市' is the printed first column header.
Continuations: 大溪郡 runs p0029 (p.6) to p0029 right (p.7); 新高郡 runs p.7 to p.8; 臺東廳 p.9 to p.10. Each is written once.

Names are separated by a single space; a name broken over two printed lines is rejoined. 「街庄ヲ置カサル蕃地」 / 「街庄ヲ置カサル地域」 are printed phrases inside the lists (kept in 「」). Parenthetical notes such as (大嵙崁), (ガオガン), (霧社蕃), (トロコ蕃) are as printed.

LEGIBILITY: the scan is blurred and the aboriginal-village (蕃社) names are set in very small katakana and kanji. Dakuten/handakuten (バ/ハ/パ, ダ/タ), small ヲ/ワ/ヱ, and some kanji are the best reading and may contain errors; no OCR was used. Only places where a character could not be read at all are marked [?].

Characters marked [?]: 七星郡 sixth item '[?]溪庄' (first character unreadable); 蘇澳郡 '[?]埃' (first character); 海山郡 '詩[?]' (second character), '[?]園地' (first character) and '東[?]' (second character); 臺中市 '牛[?]' (second part unreadable); 潮州郡 '[?]クナナウ社' (small leading mark before クナナウ unreadable), '龜子籠[?]社' (fourth character) and '[?]喇社' (the one or two characters at the end of one printed line before 喇社 unreadable).

Checks (python): in every row 男+女=計 for all 13 groups and the 合計 columns equal the sum of the 12 months; within each category 內地人+本島人+外國人 = 計; in 自殺 and in 他殺 the category blocks add up to the 計 block (for 本島人, 內地人, 外國人 and 計, with 墜落 and 其ノ他 (自殺) counted by their 本島人 row) — all reconcile.
Row '自殺 入水 內地人', col '合計 — 女': the glyph is partly faded (only the upper curve of a 2 is printed clearly); read as 2 (男 2 + 女 2 = 計 4 and the monthly cells agree).

Category names read from the left stub: first characters printed in a separate column (毒, 縊, 入, 銃, 及/刃, 墜, 轢/輾, 其) and second characters beside the brace (物, 死, 水, 器, 物, 落, 壓, 他). Nil cells are printed '…' and written '…'.

Row-label order on the left page was matched to figure rows in order (figures are not always level with their labels near groups of five rows); group gaps in the print were used to check alignment.

Table spans three frames and six printed pages: the left page of each spread carries 前年ヨリ越人員 and 入監, the right page 合計 and 出監 and 年末殘留人員; read as one row.
臺中 prints only rows 內地人 男, 本島人 男/女/計, 支那人 男, 計 男/女/計 (as printed; no 內地人 女/計, no 支那人 女/計). Row labels: place or year + race (內地人, 本島人, 支那人, 計) + 男/女/計.

Small sub-figures marked (1) (朝鮮人) or (2) (蕃人) are written after the main figure, e.g. '968 (2)3', as in the printed table. They are additional to the main figure. The 計 (all-races) rows print no sub-figures; their main figures include them.

Checks (python3, main figure + sub-figure): for every row 入監 計 = sum of the six 入監 columns; 合計 = 前年ヨリ越人員 + 入監 計; 出監 計 = sum of the nine 出監 columns; 年末殘留人員 = 合計 - 出監 計; 男+女 = 計 per race block; sum of the three races = 計 block per place/year (臺中: only the printed rows); 總計 = 臺北+臺中+臺南 by race and sex. transcriber_notes: Rows: 242 lines as printed (incl. 5 sub-heading rows 刑法犯/特別法令犯 repeated at the top of each printed page where printed; data rows 237). Printed pp. 270-275 across frames p0161-p0163; table 207 ends on p. 275 (title '……終').

Row labels are written crime / race / sex as printed (e.g. '竊盜 內地人 男'); '計' in the race position is the subtotal of the races, '計' in the sex position the male+female total. Where the original prints a ditto mark 〃 (single-sex rows, or race/sex repeated from the line above) it is kept as '〃'. On p. 273 the rows headed 計 under 刑法犯 and 特別法令犯 are the group subtotals ('刑法犯 計', '特別法令犯 計'; 其ノ他 under 特別法令犯 is written '特別法令犯 其ノ他'); p. 274 '總計' is the grand total for 大正十四年; then 大正十三年, 同 十二年, 大正十一年, 同 十年, 同 九年 (p. 275). The year rows of 大正十三年 to 同 九年 are totals for all crimes.

Small sub-figures printed beneath a main figure and marked (1) or (2) are written as the main figure, a space, then the marker directly followed by its figure, e.g. '70 (1)1', '306 (2)2'. In 同 九年 內地人 男 and 計 the 拘留 cell prints only a '(1)' sub-figure with no main figure: written '(1)1'. The sub-figure is in addition to the main figure (e.g. 竊盜 內地人 男: 2+6+17+18+26+1 = 70 main, sub 1 separate; 計 col. adds the sub-figures into the groups consistently).

Figures are retail/wholesale prices in 圓 per the unit in column 單位 (units printed in the 單位 column; 同 = ditto, kept as printed; the small unit notes such as (四打入), (五十封度), (四十碼) are copied in parentheses).

Marker notation: a '(1)' printed in the left margin of a column, immediately before a figure, is written directly before that figure, e.g. '(1)32.00'. It refers to footnote (1) ハ小賣相場ナリ. The attachment of each marker to the figure on its right (not the one on its left) is inferred from the layout: all small tags (brand/quality notes) are printed to the left of the figure they qualify.

Cells with two stacked figures in one row (printed one above the other with brace tags, e.g. Taipei 醬油 內地式 44.19 / 34.85, 米粉 17.20 / 15.92, 麵索 14.11 / 13.04, 晒金巾 12.62 / 15.64, 鹽鮭 24.40 / 40.27, 彰化 胡麻 29.20 / 33.58) are written as the two figures separated by a space, top figure first. Row group '臨時部 社會事業費': the five sub-items are joined by a brace on the right; the current-year district figures (新竹州 1,590, 臺中州 378, 臺東廳 670, 計 2,638; other districts …) are printed once at the middle of the brace and are written on the group's 計 row; the sub-item rows have '' in those cells; the four year columns are printed per sub-item.
Cells printed with two dots ('..') instead of three (社會事業費 浴場費 臺東廳; 罹災救助費 計; 前年度... etc.) are written '…'.
Row '經常部 社會事業費 其ノ他', col 計: printed 1,029 (last digit blurred, read 9); the districts add to 1,031 (118+218+656+39); printed figure kept; column 臺南州 total 38,169 reconciles with 39.

Row '臨時部 補助費 勸業費補助', col 大正十三年度: ink blot on the middle digit (6,?30 / 6,?90), written [?]. Row '臨時部 補助費 其ノ他補助', col 大正十三年度: ink blot on the third digit (4,9?8), written [?]. table.title: History of the Distribution of Administrative Divisions
table.caption_extra: Title printed across the two facing pages: "HISTORY OF THE DISTRIBUTION OF" (p. 36) / "ADMINISTRATIVE DIVISIONS" (p. 37). Columns 1909–1898 on p. 36, 1897–1895 on p. 37.
transcriber_notes: The original is a bracket diagram, not a grid: each column lists the divisions in force at that date, and curly braces group the finer units of the neighbouring column(s). Rendered here as one row per finest unit (the 20 chō of November 11, 1901, with Taitō-chō split into two rows because the 1909 column divides it into Taitō-chō and Karenkō-chō); each cell gives the division whose brace (or line) covers that row, so a name printed once against a brace is repeated in every row it covers.

Where two adjacent braces meet on the same line, the unit on that line is covered by both and the cell gives both names joined by ' / ' (transcriber's convention): 1909 column — Shinko-chō (Taihoku-chō / Giran-chō), Byōritsu-chō (Shinchiku-chō / Taichū-chō), Ensuikō-chō (Kagi-chō / Tainan-chō); June 10, 1897 column — Shinchiku-chō (Taihoku-ken / Shinchiku-ken). Brace extents were judged by eye; on p. 37 the rows are not printed, so the 1897–1895 braces were aligned with the p. 36 rows by their vertical position on the facing page (approximate: the page images are offset by c. 35 px). The 1897 assignments of Tōen-chō, Shinchiku-chō and Byōritsu-chō rest on small braces and are the least certain.

Printed as such (not corrected): 'Taikoku-ken' (April 1, 1896), 'Taichū ken' without hyphen (April 1, 1896), 'Taihoku-hen' (May 21, 1895), 'Taihoku chō' without hyphen (November 11, 1901); the last row reads 'Hōkotō-chō' in 1909 and 1896–1895 but 'Hōko-chō' in 1901–1897.
Rows: 21 as rendered (20 printed lines in the November 11, 1901 column, plus the Karenkō-chō line of the 1909 column). No totals. No unreadable cells.
